subject: Request: access & provisioning artifacts for SOC2 / SIG intake
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@corpsec.acmehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access & provisioning artifacts for SOC2 / SIG intake

Hi Michael,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 / SIG intake for a renewal with Acme Health and need a focused access/provisioning packet to complete our internal risk review. Could you help us assemble the following artifacts? We don't need full exports of everything — representative samples and clear mappings are fine, plus an owner contact for any follow-ups.

Requested items (priority order):
- SSO/SAML config screenshots and metadata (IdP entityID, ACS URL, NameID format)
- 3 example SAML assertion captures (NameID format: transient / unspecified; include authnInstant)
- SCIM: delta export for provisioning events (audit window: 2027-04-15 -> 2027-04-22) and an example PATCH/create payload
- RBAC permission matrix (service account and human roles), plus a CSV mapping of role owners
- Service account inventory (create dates, owners, last-used timestamp)
- Least-privilege assessment summary (any roles with broad wildcards or unused permissions)

Attachments: I attached our latest SIG template (Acme_SIG_v2.xlsx) with the sections highlighted we need filled.

Timeline: Can you confirm what you can deliver by EOD next Wednesday (2027-04-28)? If that doesn't work, a prioritized subset by 2027-04-25 would also help.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to run the list.

Samantha Li
Security Manager, Acme Health
Samantha.Li | +1 617-555-0189

Attachment: Acme_SIG_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2.4 MB)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@corpsec.acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access & provisioning artifacts for SOC2 / SIG intake

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a scoped bundle. Quick answers / clarifying Qs inline: 

- SSO/SAML config: we can provide IdP metadata XML, the Console screenshots for assertion consumer URL and mapping, and three assertion captures. Will include NameID formats and authnInstant as requested.
- SCIM delta: Jordan can generate a delta file for 2027-04-15 through 2027-04-22. Is a JSONL sample acceptable? We can also provide a CSV manifest summarizing the changes.
- RBAC matrix + owners: Naomi will extract role<>permission matrix and owner column. We'll produce the CSV and a short summary of any high-risk roles.
- Service accounts: we can produce a filtered inventory with create_date and last_used; for last_used we rely on token-usage telemetry (not every SA emits last-used; we'll note gaps).
- Least-privilege: we have a lightweight scan that identifies roles with broad wildcards; we'll produce a short rollup (high/medium/low findings).

Delivery and format: We propose the following workback:
1) 2027-04-23: SCIM delta sample + manifest (Jordan)
2) 2027-04-25: RBAC owner CSV + service account inventory (Naomi)
3) 2027-04-27: Assertion captures + SAML metadata + least-privilege rollup

If that schedule works I'll upload artifacts to a shared Drive folder and send links. Can you confirm whether a shared Drive link is OK or do you require SFTP?

I'll mark the items in the SIG template so it's faster to review on your side.

Thanks,

--
Michael Grant
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0137

Attachment: redwood_scim_manifest_v1.csv (export manifest, 18 KB)

Forwarding Samantha's intake. Please see tasks and due-dates below. Keep the external thread on me as the owner.

Michael -> action items: please follow.

Jordan:
- Generate SCIM delta export covering 2027-04-15 -> 2027-04-22. Deliver: scim_delta_sample_20270415-22.jsonl (JSON lines) plus redwood_scim_manifest_v1.csv. Filter sensitive fields (PII) per our redaction guidance; keep id and operation type, timestamp, user and target resource type. Provide a sample PATCH payload example.
- Capture three SAML assertions (with NameID/transient + authnInstant) from our staging IdP and sanitize any PII. Save as assertion_capture_1.txt, assertion_capture_2.txt, assertion_capture_3.txt.

Naomi: 
- Produce RBAC permission matrix with role owners: rbac_owner_map_20270421.csv. Include a short CSV column that flags roles using wildcard permissions.
- Run the least-privilege script against current role set and produce a 1-page rollup (least_privilege_rollup_20270421.md).

Notes on delivery: label each file with the artifact name above. Aim for the internal drop by 2027-04-25 for the RBAC and SCIM manifest and the rest by 2027-04-27. I'll handle uploading to Drive and sending the external link.

Let me know if there are blockers.

--
Michael

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@corpsec.acmehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access & provisioning artifacts for SOC2 / SIG intake

Thanks Michael — that timeline looks good. Drive is fine for delivery; please set viewer-only links and include a short manifest in the root folder naming each file and who to contact for questions.

A few small clarifications: 
- For the SCIM delta sample, it's OK to redact personal email addresses but please keep the object id and timestamp.
- For service account last-used, if telemetry is incomplete, please include the note explaining gaps.
- For SAML assertions, sanitization is expected; please remove any Subject/NameID values that are actual PII, but keep the NameID format strings and authnInstant timestamps.

We'll accept the prioritized deliverable set by 2027-04-25 if you can provide the SCIM manifest + RBAC owner CSV by then; the remaining artifacts (assertion captures + least-privilege rollup) by 2027-04-27 is fine.

Once we have the Drive link we will review and follow up with any clarifying questions.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
